{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "polarity_hbond_core_restored",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "heteroatom_rich_bonus",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": 0.9,
          "rationale": "Multiple N/O sites donate and accept hydrogen bonds to water, the dominant favorable term in hydration free energy."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "moderate_heteroatom_bonus",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_mid"},
          "weight": 0.45,
          "rationale": "Intermediate polar counts keep hydration sites exposed without a large apolar scaffold burying them."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "halogen_heavy_penalty",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_high"},
          "weight": -0.7,
          "rationale": "Halogen-rich solutes are weakly polar; polarizability does not compensate for lost hydrogen bonding with water."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "small_hydrocarbon_reversal",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_none", "smiles_length_bin": "smiles_short"},
          "weight": -0.6,
          "rationale": "Reverses the low-confidence source short-SMILES bonus: short heteroatom-free strings are alkanes with entropically costly hydration."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 0.8,
      "prior_scale": 0.5,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.55,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.25,
      "ucb_weight": 0.55,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 0.9,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.7,
      "hypothesis": "Restores the heteroatom/halogen polarity core plus the short-apolar reversal that scored highest on development seeds. It fails if top hydration candidates are small polar-free species or halogenated polar solutes."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "hydrophobic_surface_ring_prior_reversal",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "heteroatom_rich_bonus",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": 0.8,
          "rationale": "Dense N/O functionality maximizes solute-water hydrogen bonds, the leading favorable hydration contribution."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "pure_hydrocarbon_penalty",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_none", "halogen_bin": "halogen_none"},
          "weight": -0.7,
          "rationale": "Heteroatom-free and halogen-free solutes are pure hydrocarbons with cavity-formation costs and no hydrogen bonding."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "ring_prior_reversal_bonus",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_low"},
          "weight": 0.35,
          "rationale": "Downweights the source acyclic bonus: single rings frequently carry polar or heterocyclic substituents that hydrate favorably."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "moderate_halogen_penalty",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_mid"},
          "weight": -0.4,
          "rationale": "Partial halogenation already shifts surface toward apolar character and reduces water-accessible hydrogen-bond sites."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.4,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.45,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.15,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.1,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.015,
      "confidence": 0.55,
      "hypothesis": "Tests a hydrophobic-surface framing while reversing the high-transfer-weight source acyclic prior toward mildly cyclic polar scaffolds. It fails if rings mainly mark apolar aromatics that hydrate poorly."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "polarity_hbond_core_restored",
  "lesson": "Across two generations the heteroatom/halogen polarity core carried performance, while replacing the short-plus-apolar interaction with a rare aromatic_high penalty (only 3 candidates) coincided with a drop from ~83 to ~75 mean development AUC; low-coverage rules add little signal, though seed variation limits causal claims.",
  "revision_summary": "Restored the generation-0 polarity skill's high-coverage rule set, dropping the rare aromatic_high term and slightly strengthening the heteroatom bonus, with its original moderate decaying semantic mass. Paired it with a counter-hypothesis that reverses the high-transfer-weight source acyclic prior and frames hydration via hydrophobic surface (pure-hydrocarbon and partial-halogen penalties). Deployed the restored polarity core."
}
